source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Αντίγονος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους» and «Αγιος Αντιγονος». Its whole notice is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Αντίγονος μαρτύρησε δια πυρός» — he was martyred by fire. No year, no place, no persecutor, no rank beyond Άγιος and no hymn, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`. The four notes the page prints above it — Antigone the daughter of Oedipus, three Macedonian kings among Alexander's successors, a bronze-sculptor of Karystos of the third century before Christ and a poet of Karystos who flourished about 30 BC — are saint.gr's remarks on who else has borne the name and say nothing of this saint. The corpus holds no saint of this name under any spelling. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
